lead.title: UK-PRISM: Nightingale Health and Alamar Biosciences to measure hundreds of proteins across 80,000 UK Biobank samples
lead.deck: The study, funded in part by Alzheimer's Research UK and LifeArc, will use Alamar's NULISA platform, run in Nightingale's labs, to map the earliest biological changes linked to Alzheimer's and Parkinson's. The dataset, open to researchers from end-2027, is a training ground for future early-detection blood tests.

milestone.title: Abbott starts pivotal trial of its Cephea mitral valve, with enrollment in Europe
milestone.summary: Up to 585 patients with moderate-to-severe mitral regurgitation or mitral annular calcification will be enrolled in the US, Canada and Europe; a Wichita, Kansas hospital enrolled the first patient.
milestone.why: Transcatheter mitral valve replacement (TMVR) reaches pivotal stage at a major player: a validation signal for European startups such as HighLife and InnovHeart.

brefsEurope.title: J&J presents the European TRI-GUARD-PCI registry at TCT 2026: 6.1% 30-day mortality on Impella
brefsEurope.summary: Across 279 patients at German, Swiss and Austrian centres, all-cause mortality is 6.1% at 30 days and 7.9% at 180 days; J&J sets these observational data against the CHIP-BCIS3 trial (about 8%). A market comparable: results from an established player, with PROTECT IV due in 2027.

brefsEurope.title: MTIP launches EverHealth, a Luxembourg ELTIF evergreen fund for European healthtech
brefsEurope.summary: The fund will invest directly, in follow-ons in MTIP portfolio companies and in secondaries, with quarterly subscriptions and redemptions in EUR and CHF. Size undisclosed; open for subscriptions.

brefsIntl.title: FDA expands indication of Instylla's Embrace HES embolic hydrogel to peripheral arterial bleeds
brefsIntl.summary: Cleared for vessels up to 6 mm, backed by the HALT trial (130 patients, 22 US centres): 100% freedom from major adverse events at 30 days and 90% clinical success. A resorbable PEG hydrogel worth watching in biomaterials.

word.fr: Replacing the mitral valve without open-heart surgery
word.definition: A technique that implants an artificial valve in the heart through a catheter, without opening the chest, to treat a leaking mitral valve.

parts.label: Prosthetic valve
parts.role: takes over the function of the failing native valve

parts.label: Anchoring
parts.role: holds the valve in the anatomically complex mitral annulus

parts.label: Delivery system
parts.role: catheter (often trans-septal) that brings the valve to the heart

how.t: The catheter enters through the femoral vein and crosses the septum between the atria.
The valve is guided under imaging to the mitral annulus.
The valve is anchored; obstruction of the left ventricular outflow tract (LVOT) must be avoided.

word.why: Mitral leaks are common and few patients are operable: TMVR is still an open device class, with pivotal trials starting (Abbott Cephea) and nine-figure rounds. Risks to watch: anchoring, LVOT obstruction and durability.

startups.name: HighLife
startups.use: Transfemoral valve-in-ring TMVR system; CE mark for the Clarity valve, over $90M raised in September 2026 (Andera, Sofinnova, Supernova Invest, Mérieux Equity Partners) for the US pivotal study

startups.name: InnovHeart
startups.use: Saturn TMVR prosthesis in the European CASSINI-EU trial; first-in-human implant in Lithuania in May 2024; Series C of over $55M led by Grand Pharmaceutical

startups.name: 4C Medical Technologies
startups.use: AltaValve system in the ATLAS pivotal trial (US and Europe); $175M Series D led by Boston Scientific; two FDA Breakthrough designations
